text: In bottom-up (shotgun) proteomics, which enzyme is standard for digesting proteins into peptides, cleaving after lysine (K) and arginine (R) residues?
explanation: Trypsin is the standard protease in shotgun proteomics, cleaving C-terminal to lysine and arginine to generate peptides in the 6-25 residue range that are ideal for MS/MS fragmentation and sequencing. Chymotrypsin instead cleaves after aromatic residues, while pepsin and proteinase K are broader-specificity proteases used in other, less standard contexts.
